death.note: Stated as a reign and never recorded. This folder’s own life makes him a son of Claudius and Praepedigna and «a family of the emperor Diocletian’s kin, baptised after talking with the household of the virgin Susanna, exiled when the emperor» turned on them; `susanna-the-deaconess` carries floruit end of the 3rd century. The interval is Diocletian’s reign, 284–305, which is how sixty-five other folders in this corpus hold that marker. No year, because the page gives none.
